title: ML Training and Inference Lab
description: Version 1.1: corrected Linux process-memory measurements; a post-hoc six-capacity Fashion-MNIST sweep; and a fixed twelve-task multi-file coding repair evaluation with custom JSON tool actions, visible-test feedback, immutable task/harness hashes and withheld host-side grading inside network-disabled Docker. Complete trajectories, failures, limits and grader validation are included. Developed with coding-agent assistance. Checkpoints are distributed separately in the GitHub release. The hidden evaluator is private, so full independent public replay is not claimed. Version 1.0 remains archived unchanged; its Linux memory comparison is inconclusive.
